resources.string: Enter your Tvheadend address in Settings to load your channels.
Check that Tvheadend is running and that the address and port in Settings are right.
It accepted the connection but didn\'t reply in time. Check that the port is the HTSP port (9982, or 9983 with TLS).
Tvheadend didn\'t accept the username or password. Check them in Settings.
Compare the fingerprint with the one in Tvheadend and trust it to connect.
Not connected, for your safety. If you replaced the certificate in Tvheadend, clear the fingerprint in Settings.
Check that TLS is enabled on the server and that the port is its TLS port (usually 9983).
Check the server settings, or wait while the app tries again.
